pr_title: Fix TypeScript and other sourcemaps by always creating an initial sourcemap
pr_body:
Fixes #6191. Fixes #6457.

# ↪️ Pull Request

<!---
Provide a general summary of the pull request here
Please look for any issues that this PR resolves and tag them in the PR.
-->
Unconditionally create an initial sourcemap for assets. This should fix issues with sourcemaps showing transpiled code instead of source contents in typescript (and other languages not included in the set) projects.

Do we want to do it this way or move the assignment to asset.sourceContent out of this if statement? This would also be a problem for other languages like coffeescript. I think the original purpose of the extensions list was for loading source map comments. What do you think, @DeMoorJasper?
I think the other solution is way better a ts file will never have a sourcemap comment so there's no point in reading it? Probably just wastes processing time

Is the test failing because we don't have the preset?

They should be added here:

https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/blob/3492ad0449b7a7143e165d8b0c11d78f6672266a/packages/core/integration-tests/package.json#L15-L20

it's more of a coincidence that the flow and react presets area already listed in some other monorepo packages

~~Just pushed a change that changes asset's `getStream` api to always return a new copy of a stream and `setStream` to accept a function that returns a stream.~~ This is now #6516

However, a couple issues remain, and can probably be addressed outside this PR:
* We're still inlining content even though the user may not has asked for it. We should be checking `options.sourceMap.inlineSources` and not reading these in for most cases (aside from runtimes)
* Large JS sources read as streams due to their size are buffered entirely into memory to read them as sourceContents. While this could probably be addressed by allowing the sourcemaps library to read and write streams (cc @DeMoorJasper), the JSTransformer still needs to work with the entire buffer (and probably will continue to unless we develop a streaming JS transformer in the future), see: https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/pull/6516#issuecomment-868896437

cc @devongovett @gorakong

issue_context.title: Sourcemaps only showing compiled code after upgrade to v2
issue_context.body:
# 🐛 bug report

After upgrading to Parcel v2, sourcemaps are showing compiled code.

## 🎛 Configuration (.babelrc, package.json, cli command)

babel.config.json

```js
{
  "presets": [
    "@babel/preset-env",
    "@babel/preset-react",
    "@babel/preset-typescript"
  ]
}

```

package.json
```json
"scripts": {
    "build": "parcel build public/index.html --no-scope-hoist",
    "dev": "parcel public/index.html",
```

## 🤔 Expected Behavior

Expecting to see sourcemaps, like when using parcel v1

## 😯 Current Behavior

Only seeing compiled code sourcemaps in `__parcel_source_root`
The end of the index.js file shows `//# sourceMappingURL=index.ed731f93.js.map`

## 🌍 Your Environment

<!--- Include as many relevant details about the environment you experienced the bug in -->

| Software         | Version(s) |
| ---------------- | ---------- |
| Parcel           | 2.0.0-beta.3 and 2.0.0-beta.3.1
| Node             | v15.14.0 and v16
| npm/Yarn         |  7.13.0
| Operating System | Mac OS Big Sur

👉  https://opencollective.com/parcel/donate -->

review_comments: This passed before and I'm not sure adds much value, but it verifies the fact that even though streams are not read to create sourceContent, this works since the sourcemaps code always buffers streams first, see: https://github.com/parcel-bundler/parcel/pull/6516#issuecomment-868896437
Will this end up creating a string representation of binary content? Maybe we can do this on demand when calling setMap?

This would be an issue as a common pattern is `let map = asset.getMap(); myMap.extend(map); asset.setMap(map);`, but by the time we lazily initialize a map inside setMap, getMap would already be called and it returns empty then.

What about doing this lazily in getMap instead?
Well we only want to do it for the first transformer in a pipeline
Isn't that a separate problem from getMap/setMap?
Not sure if I'm missing something here, but wouldn't `asset.getCode()` return transpiled code by the time we get to `set/getMap`?
